about: Classes named like a group heading that still set their own type look, each with why. group_head_census.test.mjs fails on a new one and on one listed here that no longer sets a look: the list only goes down.

classes.session-group-header: the sidebar's group row (name, count, chevron): slice 4's list rows
classes.group-name-line: its name line, the same row
classes.group-name-text: its name text, the same row
classes.theme-group-title: a group title inside the theme editor dialog: the dialogs and form rows slices
